specs.name: longestIncreasingSubsequence_le_length
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : longestIncreasingSubsequence_precond nums),
    longestIncreasingSubsequence nums h_precond = nums.length

specs.name: longestIncreasingSubsequence_nonneg
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : longestIncreasingSubsequence_precond nums),
    0 = longestIncreasingSubsequence nums h_precond

specs.name: longestIncreasingSubsequence_result_is_valid_subseq_length
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : longestIncreasingSubsequence_precond nums),
    let allSubseq := (nums.foldl fun acc x == acc ++ acc.map (fun sub => x :: sub)) [[]] |>.map List.reverse
    let increasingSubseqLens := allSubseq.filter (fun l => List.Pairwise (· = ·) l) |>.map (·.length)
    increasingSubseqLens.contains (longestIncreasingSubsequence nums h_precond)

specs.name: longestIncreasingSubsequence_is_maximum
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : longestIncreasingSubsequence_precond nums),
    let allSubseq := (nums.foldl fun acc x == acc ++ acc.map (fun sub => x :: sub)) [[]] |>.map List.reverse
    let increasingSubseqLens := allSubseq.filter (fun l => List.Pairwise (· = ·) l) |>.map (·.length)
    increasingSubseqLens.all (· = longestIncreasingSubsequence nums h_precond)

specs.name: longestIncreasingSubsequence_append_ge
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (x : Int) (h1 : longestIncreasingSubsequence_precond nums)
      (h2 : longestIncreasingSubsequence_precond (nums ++ [x])),
    longestIncreasingSubsequence nums h1 = longestIncreasingSubsequence (nums ++ [x]) h2

specs.name: longestIncreasingSubsequence_two_sorted
specs.stmt:
∀ (x y : Int) (h : x = y) (h_precond : longestIncreasingSubsequence_precond [x, y]),
    longestIncreasingSubsequence [x, y] h_precond = 2

specs.name: longestIncreasingSubsequence_pos_of_nonempty
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : longestIncreasingSubsequence_precond nums),
    nums ≠ [] → 1 = longestIncreasingSubsequence nums h_precond

specs.name: longestIncreasingSubsequence_meets_postcond
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : longestIncreasingSubsequence_precond nums),
    longestIncreasingSubsequence_postcond nums (longestIncreasingSubsequence nums h_precond) h_precond
